    w=p[0]

    c=np.linalg.lstsq(X,y,rcond=None)[0]

from scipy.optimize import least_squares
t=df['t'].values; P=df['P'].values; y=df['dP_dt'].values
def res(p):
    X=np.column_stack([t, np.sin(p[0]*t)/P, P*np.log(P), t/P])
    c=np.linalg.lstsq(X,y,rcond=None)[0]
    return y-X@c
